descriptions: What the agent writes per prompts/review.md and report --cost rolls up. One object per run, or an array when a bundle was reviewed more than once. The script only sums — it never prices: effort defaults to standard when missing or unknown, records without models still count as runs but not as runs_with_cost, absent/unreadable records contribute zeros and never fail. Per-chunk records (chunks/<name>.cost.json) share this shape. Unknown keys are ignored by the rollup, so this schema allows them.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/effort: Run tier; missing or unknown values roll up as standard.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/models: One entry per model that generated tokens: the synthesizer first, then each lens.
descriptions./$defs/record/properties/est_usd: The agent's own math from its price sheet, null when prices are unknown — never guessed.
descriptions./$defs/modelSpend/properties/cache_read_: Input tokens served from cache; a subset of input_tokens, never an addition. Absent or null reads as unknown, never zero.
descriptions./$defs/modelSpend/properties/cache_creat: Input tokens spent writing the cache; a subset of input_tokens, never an addition. Absent or null reads as unknown, never zero.

descriptions: Every --json stdout is exactly one envelope with these eight keys (schema_version "1"): error null on success with a data object, data null with a typed error object on refusal. Derived from json_redirect/fail and every verb's jq -n emitter in scripts/review.sh. data is additive per verb (chunk summaries, prompt_dump, cost, completeness ride inside data, never as new top-level keys), so data objects allow additional properties; only report, post and record carry a pinned data shape here ($defs, validated explicitly) — the remaining verbs keep the generic object shape until their data stabilizes.
descriptions./properties/pr: Numeric PR, else null (local slugs never coerce).
descriptions./$defs/error: Refusal shape from fail(): data is null, message carries the cause plus a try: hint, candidates rides only on the oversize-fetch refusal.
descriptions./$defs/findingItem: Ranked or merged finding locator shared by report items and post/record items.
descriptions./$defs/provenance: Review provenance triple: the tooling behind a run, so mixed-version histories never read as one series. The writer always emits all three keys; model is null when no cost record names one.
descriptions./$defs/reportData: report --json data: ranked read over the store. cost appears only with --cost, completeness only with --completeness, receipt keys only when budget.json parses.
descriptions./$defs/reportCost: Summed rollup from cost.json plus per-chunk records; by_tier always carries all three tiers.
descriptions./$defs/reportCost/properties/cached_inpu: Summed per-model cache_read_input_tokens plus cache_creation_input_tokens; totals stay input + output exactly.
descriptions./$defs/postData: post --dry-run --json data (dry_run true, findings carry the dry-run file) and real-post data (dry_run false, findings carry counts plus the accepted review object).
descriptions./$defs/postData/properties/review: Real-post only: the accepted GitHub review object.
descriptions./$defs/recordData: record --json data: the local-bundle merge (post stays refused, no PR target).

descriptions: What post/record write per bundle. Derived from validate_and_merge in scripts/review.sh: stable line-number-free sigs, append-only history, re-post merges that keep prior fields ($prev + new, so unknown keys pass through — this schema allows them). rigor is always normalized to the enum, severity to the enum-or-null, kb defaults to []. Section entries carry anchored:"body" instead of a boolean.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/sig: Stable cross-run join key: SHA-1 of path + heading + body, whitespace-squashed.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/sig_version: Normalization generation; backfilled onto older entries, never clobbered.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/heading: Section findings only: the exact ### body heading.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/anchored: Inline: true when the anchor sits inside one reviewed hunk. Section: the string "body".
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/kb: Cited knowledge-base rule ids; [] when uncited.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/inBounds: CamelCase in the store (hyphenated in review.json input); absent reads true.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/rigor: Evidence rung on inline findings; the re-post merge stamps an explicit null onto section entries.
descriptions./$defs/entry/properties/history: Append-only: reported, claim, reopened, revalidation, addressed, triaged.

descriptions: Written only by the real-post path in scripts/review.sh (dry runs, attempts and failures write nothing), so a present head matching the bundle HEAD proves a completed post. review is raw GitHub output (GitHub's schema, unversioned) — this schema passes it through. confidence/security_summary are absent-stays-absent: null when the review carried none. additionalProperties stays open for additive provenance fields.
descriptions./properties/review: Raw GitHub review object: id, html_url and whatever the API returned.
descriptions./properties/head: Reviewed commit SHA; doubles as the single-review finalizer key.
descriptions./properties/posted_at: UTC timestamp of the completed post.
descriptions./properties/tool_version: Tool version that wrote this record (from package.json).
descriptions./properties/prompts_hash: sha256 over the sorted prompt-set file names plus contents (SKILL.md plus prompts/system.md, prompts/review.md, prompts/diagrams.md).
descriptions./properties/model: First model of the latest cost record, else null when no cost record names one.

descriptions: Written by the record verb in scripts/review.sh for local and provider-PR bundles (GitHub PRs use post). findings/open are recomputed from the merged store every run; confidence/security_summary are null when the review carried none. additionalProperties stays open for additive provenance fields.
descriptions./properties/status: Bundle provider that was recorded (e.g. local).
descriptions./properties/head: Reviewed SHA (real head_sha, or "dirty"/"unknown" when the bundle has none).
descriptions./properties/diff_sha256: SHA-256 of full.diff at record time.
descriptions./properties/recorded_at: UTC timestamp of the record run.
descriptions./properties/tool_version: Tool version that wrote this record (from package.json).
descriptions./properties/prompts_hash: sha256 over the sorted prompt-set file names plus contents (SKILL.md plus prompts/system.md, prompts/review.md, prompts/diagrams.md).
descriptions./properties/model: First model of the latest cost record, else null when no cost record names one.

descriptions: What the agent writes and post/record validate. Derived from validate_and_merge in scripts/review.sh and the review.json block in docs/manual.md: unknown schema_version refuses, missing warns; out-of-range confidence and non-string security_summary warn-and-drop; unknown anchor paths and non-numeric anchors are kept with a warning, provably-outside anchors move to the body; unknown rigor/severity values fall back (pointed/null). Unknown top-level keys are ignored by the script, so this schema allows them.
descriptions./properties/schema_version: Agents stamp "1"; post/record refuse anything else.
descriptions./properties/body: Full review text, verdict marker first line.
descriptions./properties/approved: Binding ask; the CLI --bind/--request-changes flags win over this.
descriptions./properties/resolved: Finding sigs (full or unambiguous prefix) the run addresses. Bare claims only record history; addressed needs verification.json evidence.
descriptions./properties/triage: Status claims with rationale. Unknown status refuses the run; unknown sig warns; rationale under 30 chars keeps the prior status.
descriptions./properties/sections: Severity tags for ### body sections; exact heading string, unmatched tags ignored.
descriptions./properties/confidence: Review-level certainty, integer 1-5; out-of-range warns and drops.
descriptions./properties/security_summary: One-paragraph security read; non-string warns and drops.
descriptions./properties/chunks: Coverage attestation on chunked bundles: every manifest chunk name the synthesis covers. Attested-but-partial coverage is refused.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/path: Diff-relative path; unknown paths are kept with a warning, never refused.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/line: NEW-side line; numeric strings anchor like integers, non-numeric anchors are kept with a warning.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/start_line: Multi-line range start; same tolerance as line.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/side: Defaults to RIGHT; case-insensitive, LEFT for deleted lines.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/suggestion: Fenced suggestions demote to the body (a fence inside would break rendering).
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/rigor: Evidence rung; unknown values read as pointed.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/severity: Stored at write time; unknown values read as null.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/in-bounds: Hyphenated in agent input; absent reads true.
descriptions./$defs/comment/properties/kb: Cited knowledge-base rule ids the script normalizes; malformed ids warn and drop.
